text:
lee: quick ping 1: we're proposing a tiny tf apply for tightening the network-role trust policy (cross-account assume). scheduling for Wed change window. low-risk but it's touching trust relationships so want rollout + rollback spelled out.

tara: which PR? link pls.

lee: https://git.internal/infra/pull/4823 - changes in modules/network/iam.tf (trust policy only, 12 LOC).

noah: ok to tighten but need to verify that partner account bindings aren't removed. recommend canary in eu-west-1 first.

sre-oncall: we'll do staged smoke + synthetic auth to verify cross-account calls. I can watch for errors.

lee: proposed rollout:
- staging apply (auto)
- prod canary in eu-west-1 (instances tagged net-canary)
- monitor 15m (synthetics + error budget checks)
- full prod rollout if canary passes

tara: add metric triggers: any cross-account STS AssumeRole failure spikes >0.5% of requests OR increased 5xxs from network services >15% sustained for 10m -> rollback.

lee: rollback plan: revert to commit hash `c7a9f2b` and run `terraform apply` in the affected workspace (we keep the previous tfstate). we won't try to patch the policy in-place. ops runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/net/4823-rollback

devops-bot: @deploybot preflight summary: plan shows in-place update to aws_iam_role_policy with 0 replacements, 0 deletions. provider pinned in canary workspace. CI: https://ci.internal/build/12003 :white_check_mark:

deploybot: change window queued for 2026-04-01T03:30:00Z. react with :white_check_mark: to confirm. Job queued id=6022.

noah: suggest provider pin in canary and snapshot the module commit to avoid drift during canary. also post a short downtime blurb in release notes in case some agents need to re-auth.

lee: will do provider pin + snapshot commit. release notes blurb: "Minor IAM trust tighten for network role; possible transient auth retries for cross-account callers."

devops-bot: preflight plan snippet:
```
# aws_iam_role.trusted_service will be updated in-place
~ resource "aws_iam_role" "trusted_service" {
    assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
-      "Statement": [{"Action": "sts:AssumeRole", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root"}}]
+      "Statement": [{"Action": ["sts:AssumeRole"], "Principal": {"AWS": ["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root"]}}]
    })
  }
```

lee: smoke tests to run after canary apply:
- `make smoke-net` (runs cross-account auth and quick path tests)
- `curl -sS https://net-canary.eu-west-1.internal/health | jq .` expecting {"status":"ok"}

sre-oncall: i'll run synthetics and watch dashboards, have pager ready.

tara: security approve pending confirmation that no KMS/key grants changed.

lee: confirmed: only role trust statement mutated. no KMS.

deploybot: staging apply started (job 6022-staging) at 2026-03-31T23:45:12Z.

devops-bot: staging apply success - no errors. plan applied cleanly.

noah: starting prod canary apply (eu-west-1 tag net-canary).

devops-bot: prod canary apply finished at 2026-04-01T00:15:44Z - smoke `make smoke-net` passed on tagged instance. synthetic traces ok.

sre-oncall: metrics check: STS error rate 0.02% (baseline ~0.01%), latency within normal. holding 15m then proceed.

lee: proceeding to full prod in 10m unless objections. Will pin module in prod workspace before full apply.

tara: go for it. confirm release notes updated and rollback runbook attached.

deploybot: full prod apply in progress.

devops-bot: full prod apply success at 2026-04-01T00:50:02Z. release notes: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-04-01/net-iam-4823.

lee: thanks everyone. closing thread. :tada:
